info.name: Clean Cars API
info.description:
All endpoints of the Clean Cars backend.

**Getting started**
0. Import `CleanCars-Local.postman_environment.json` and select the **Clean Cars — Local** environment (every variable lives there; scripts write tokens/ids back into it).
1. Set `firebaseIdToken` in the environment to a Firebase ID token from the client SDK.
2. Run *Auth → Login with Firebase* — `accessToken` / `refreshToken` are stored automatically.
3. A brand-new user has no org: run *Billing → Subscription → Start Trial* (stores the new org-scoped token).
4. Every other request uses the collection-level Bearer `{{accessToken}}`. Create requests store the new id into the matching `…Id` variable, so Get / Update / Delete work straight after.

Lists return `PageResponse` (`page`, `size` ≤ 50, `sort=field,asc|desc`). Errors are RFC-7807 `ProblemDetail`.

item.name: Auth

request.description: Only login endpoint (Google / Apple / phone OTP all arrive as a Firebase ID token). Stores `accessToken` + `refreshToken`.
Rotates the refresh token (old one revoked). Replaying a revoked token revokes all of the user's tokens.

item.description: Permit-all. Firebase is the single identity provider — there is no password login.

item.name: Account

request.description: Public pick-lists for the org form: `timezones [{id, label}]`, `currencies [{code, symbol, label}]`. Show `label`, send `id` / `code`.
Current user + `orgName` / `orgTimezone` + slim `plan` usage (null when org-less or no live subscription).
The caller's own org (id from the token).
Owner/admin only. Full replace — omitted fields are cleared, except `name` / `timezone` / `currency` (null = unchanged).

item.name: Billing

request.description: Public plans with live Razorpay pricing. Stores the first monthly `razorpayPlanId` found.
Always 200 — `{active:false, status:"NONE"}` when there's no live subscription.
Org-less users only. Creates the org + 14-day trial and returns a fresh token carrying `org_id` (stored automatically). 409 `user_already_has_org` / `trial_already_used`.
Creates a Razorpay subscription (status `pending`) for checkout.js. 409 `org_already_subscribed`.
Up/downgrade an ACTIVE subscription; Razorpay prorates. 409 `plan_change_same_plan`.
Simulates a Razorpay event. Set `razorpayWebhookSecret` to `app.razorpay.webhook-secret`; the signature is computed in the pre-request script. Invalid signature → 401.

exec: // Signs the resolved body with HMAC-SHA256(razorpayWebhookSecret), like Razorpay does.

request.description: Flat newest-first list (not paged). `search` matches category name / notes.
`categoryName` must match one of the org's expense categories (case-insensitive), else 404.
Home snapshot: in-progress / unpaid counts, today & yesterday revenue, monthly earnings. Not plan-gated.
metric: TOTAL_SERVICE | TOTAL_REVENUE. granularity: DAY | WEEK | MONTH | YEAR. Gated by plan `stats_range_years` (409 `statistics_not_available` / `stats_range_exceeded`).
